title: Slot Filling
description: Asks for each missing required parameter in turn until the request is executable. Recorded facts — Strategy: Slot Filling; Trigger: missing parameters; Outcome: complete request. Used by conversational AI, support bots, and command interfaces to avoid acting on misunderstood requests.
demo:
# Slot Filling — runnable demo (python3)
# Slot Filling - slot completeness (python3)
filled=4
total=7
min_ratio=0.8
ratio=filled/total
print("slots filled: %d/%d (%.0f%%)" % (filled, total, ratio*100))
print("READY TO ACT" if ratio >= min_ratio else "ASK MORE")
